name: io.github.meet30997/codex-openai-image-mcp
title: Codex / OpenAI Image
description: Generate, edit and make matching sets of images with the Codex CLI or the OpenAI Images API

environmentVariables.name: IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Image backend: codex-cli (your ChatGPT plan via the Codex CLI), openai-api, or mock

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key, only needed for the openai-api backend

environmentVariables.name: IMAGEGEN_OUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for generated images, relative to the working folder (default generated-images)
